scope: screenshot after the phase falls to 0, to decide whether the phase value matters for playability

evidence.dialog: 错误 / 很遗憾，你来了晚了，游戏刚刚结束！ (with an 退出 button)
evidence.background: the crossfire world is still rendered (grey ground, texture detail, centre reticle)

interpretation.dialog_changed: previous rounds showed 'server connection timed out'; this round shows 'you came too late, the match has just ended'
interpretation.meaning: the client is not merely loading any more: it has joined the match and the match has already reached its end. The phase falling to 0 is consistent with the client reacting to a finished match, not with a broken connect
interpretation.caveat: the dedrun instance had been running for several minutes before the client joined, so the match may genuinely have hit its score/time limit
